runConfig.positivePrompt: Static wide camera. Exactly one Tyrannosaurus rex on the right bank makes one large, clearly readable non-contact attack feint toward exactly one Triceratops horridus on the left bank. The Tyrannosaurus rapidly thrusts its deep head and muscular neck forward toward the stream, opens and snaps its jaws once, then recoils slightly. The Triceratops quickly lowers its solid frill and three horns into a defensive brace. Make both reactions obvious across the frame. Both dinosaurs remain on their original dry banks with the open stream between them and never touch. Keep the Tyrannosaurus two tiny arms, two legs, and tail complete; keep the Triceratops three horns, four legs, and tail complete. No steps, no collision, no injury. Preserve the attached identities, forest, water, ground, lighting, crop, and fixed camera. Silent, non-graphic generated ecology hypothesis for ages five to fourteen.
